{{Quote|Visit the Water Planet Praya|An advertisement for the Deluxe Undersea Package on Tourscan|<ref name="Star Tours" />}}
'''Praya''' was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Star Tours" /> located in the [[Praya system/Legends|Praya system]], within the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> it was home to the luxurious [[Sea Castle Resort Hotel]]. The [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency facilitated transit to Praya through their [[Deluxe Undersea Package]].<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
Praya first appeared in an advertisement on [[Tourscan]] at the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction, which opened on [[July 12]], [[1989]].<ref name="Star Tours" /> [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] placed it in grid square K-4.<ref name="EAOC" />

The location and footage were reused from the Sea Castle ending segment from [[Wikipedia:Horizons (Epcot)|Horizons]], a now-defunct [[Wikipedia:Epcot|Epcot]] ride, which focused on the concept of [[Wikipedia:Ocean colonization|ocean colonization]]. The models for Horizons' three ending segments were designed, constructed, and filmed by [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] special effects veteran [[David Jones]].<ref name="Epcot">{{WebCite|url=http://progresscityusa.com/2011/09/01/the-horizons-story-part-iii-disneys-house-of-magic|text=The Horizons Story, Part III: Disney's House Of Magic|author=Michael Crawford|date=2011-09-24|work=The Horizons Story|archivedate=20110924203238}}</ref> The model for the ocean segment was made in two parts: an underwater city and an underwater canyon, which were visually joined by a pass though the total darkness of the ocean depths.<ref name="Horizons Pavilion">{{WebCite|url=http://www.kesigndesign.com/code/horizon1.shtml|text=Choose Your Tomorrow attraction, Horizon Pavilion, EPCOT, Walt Disney World Visual Effects - Model and Prop Builder and Special Effects.|author=Kenneth A. Larson|archivedate=20140327071735}}</ref>
